broaderSuite.note: The broader all-subject suite fails 72 assertions expecting the literal Activity outcome in existing science discussion wording. The same 72 wording assertion failures were also reproduced against the baseline code. Those assertions were not changed or suppressed. No live AI generation or factual certification was performed.

causes: Visually equivalent bond dashes and apostrophes did not match source headings.
Focused paragraphs naming their subject once lost follow-up explanatory sentences.
Some topic names differ from verified NCERT section headings.
Transient official-mirror failures had no retry.
Plain Science metadata could be considered for Computer Science or Social Science.
method: Read-only controlled source-recovery audit, using the same uploaded source snapshot and same exact official mirror chapter text for before/after. Includes catalog titles and a typographic en-dash title variant where applicable. Each successful recovery is rebuilt through buildLocalSections and checked by topicSourceComplete. A failure means recovery could not safely populate a sparse topic; it does not prove that every ordinary AI generation for this topic fails. Before counts are reproduced audit failures, not historical website error logs. No full live AI generation, browser rendering, or factual certification is claimed. No uploaded content or saved lessons were modified.
